optional_params.stability: omit (provider default) unless a take is flat (try 0.35) or unstable (try 0.55)

primary.output: 44.1 kHz mono mp3 at result_url; download with curl into workspace/brand_reels/tts/hf_dl/<reel>/

alternate.note: fallback only if Higgsfield is unavailable; different timbre, so never mix voices inside one reel

text_style: DEV: Devanagari text tuned for Hindi TTS (nuktas where Urdu-natural, English loan words in Devanagari phonetics, numbers spelled out, commas/ellipses for pauses). The nickname JD is written जे-डी.
post_processing: trim leading/trailing silence to 40 ms; cap internal pauses at 0.45 s except deliberate dramatic beats
time-stretch 1.06-1.10x with rubberband/ffmpeg atempo (pitch-preserving) to land ~155-165 wpm for reels
high-pass 70 Hz, gentle de-ess, light compression, normalise VO stem to -16 LUFS integrated before the mix
word timings: faster-whisper word_timestamps on the final processed take; captions use the Roman Urdu track
generation_policy: generate per beat or per 1-3 sentences (better control, cheap re-takes) rather than one whole-reel take; join with crossfades in the timeline
never resubmit blindly; poll job ids with jobs_wait
Higgsfield credit budget: project cap 250; casting spent 62.71 (balance 7255.02 -> 7192.31); remaining 187.29 for final VO + fixes (~2.5 credits per ~520-char take)
